import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import messagebox

class CalorieCounter:
    def __init__(self):
        self.root = tk.Tk()
        self.root.title("Calorie Counter")
        self.calorie_goal = 0
        self.calorie_consumed = 0

        # Create input fields for calorie goal and consumed calories
        self.goal_label = tk.Label(self.root, text="Daily Calorie Goal:")
        self.goal_entry = tk.Entry(self.root)
        self.consumed_label = tk.Label(self.root, text="Calories Consumed:")
        self.consumed_entry = tk.Entry(self.root)

        # Create buttons for calculating calories and displaying progress
        self.calculate_button = tk.Button(self.root, text="Calculate", command=self.calculate_calories)
        self.progress_button = tk.Button(self.root, text="Progress", command=self.display_progress)

        # Layout the widgets
        self.goal_label.grid(row=0, column=0)
        self.goal_entry.grid(row=0, column=1)
        self.consumed_label.grid(row=1, column=0)
        self.consumed_entry.grid(row=1, column=1)
        self.calculate_button.grid(row=2, column=0)
        self.progress_button.grid(row=2, column=1)

    def calculate_calories(self):
        try:
            self.calorie_goal = int(self.goal_entry.get())
            self.calorie_consumed = int(self.consumed_entry.get())
            if self.calorie_consumed > self.calorie_goal:
                messagebox.showerror("Error", "Calories consumed exceeds daily goal!")
            else:
                messagebox.showinfo("Calories Consumed", f"You have consumed {self.calorie_consumed} calories out of your daily goal of {self.calorie_goal} calories.")
        except ValueError:
            messagebox.showerror("Error", "Invalid input! Please enter a valid number.")

    def display_progress(self):
        if self.calorie_consumed > 0:
            progress = (self.calorie_consumed / self.calorie_goal) * 100
            messagebox.showinfo("Progress", f"You have reached {progress}% of your daily calorie goal!")
        else:
            messagebox.showinfo("Progress", "No calories consumed yet!")

    def run(self):
        self.root.mainloop()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app = CalorieCounter()
    app.run()
```
This code creates a simple GUI application with input fields for calorie goal and consumed calories, buttons for calculating calories and displaying progress, and a main loop to run the application.
